info.name: ABTalks AI Interview Agent
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ABTalks AI Interview Agent.

Quick start:
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to http://localhost:3000
2. Run 'Health Check' to confirm the server is up
3. Run '1. Start Interview (Sarah Johnson)' to begin
4. Run '2. Send Message' — edit the message body to enter candidate answers
5. Repeat step 4 until the response contains `done: true`
6. The final response will include the full feedback block

Tip: The sessionId is auto-captured into a collection variable after each start request.
